metadata.medianRule: Median of three valid Lighthouse lab runs for each page type and device; no averaging.

fieldData.reason: The PageSpeed Insights API returned HTTP 429; no URL-level or origin-level CrUX field data was retrieved. INP is therefore not reported.

measurementNotes: All tests were read-only GET navigations to public pages. No cart mutation, checkout, payment, or order action was performed.
Lighthouse output is normalized to the requested raw audit values, resource summaries, layout-shift causes, and third-party host totals; full traces and screenshots are not included.
Lighthouse reset browser storage/cache between runs; origin/CDN cache state and the test runner location were not controlled.
The CuppaCode storefront has not been measured in this dataset; a localhost run would not be presented as a production comparison.

notes: Counts above refer to the public homepage HTML response, not the number of unique extensions or resources ultimately requested.
The Lighthouse network records capture assets requested during the test, including delayed third-party code where it fired.
